sources.title: PocketBase GitHub Repository
sources.keyClaim: Open source Go backend with 60.2k stars, MIT license, single-binary architecture, embedded SQLite

sources.title: PocketBase Documentation - Introduction
sources.keyClaim: Embedded SQLite with realtime subscriptions, built-in auth, admin dashboard, REST API. Pre-v1.0 warning.

sources.title: PocketBase Documentation - JavaScript Extension
sources.keyClaim: ES5 JS engine (goja), pb_hooks/*.pb.js, isolated handler contexts, 15-runtime pool, no modern JS/TS in hooks

sources.title: PocketBase Documentation - API Records
sources.keyClaim: Full CRUD, filter syntax with 12+ operators, batch operations, relation expansion, field selection

sources.title: PocketBase Documentation - API Realtime
sources.keyClaim: SSE-based realtime, subscribe to collection or record, custom messages via subscriptionsBroker

sources.title: PocketBase Documentation - Going to Production
sources.keyClaim: Deployment: binary upload, reverse proxy, Docker, systemd. Security: rate limiter, IP whitelist, MFA, settings encryption.

sources.title: PocketBase JavaScript SDK
sources.keyClaim: 2.9k stars, TypeScript, Browser/Node/React Native, auth store, auto-cancellation, SSR patterns for SvelteKit/Astro/Nuxt/Next

sources.title: PocketBase Documentation - JS Realtime Messaging
sources.keyClaim: Custom realtime messages via $app.subscriptionsBroker(), SubscriptionMessage, client-side subscribe
